import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate the CSV by medical department
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv')
totals = df.groupby('診療科', as_index=False)['患者数'].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.bar(totals['診療科'], totals['患者数'], color=['#d95f02' if d == '内科' else '#9ecae1' for d in totals['診療科']])
ax.set_title('診療科ごとの患者数合計')
ax.set_xlabel('診療科')
ax.set_ylabel('患者数（人）')
ax.set_ylim(0, totals['患者数'].max() * 1.12)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25)
for i, v in enumerate(totals['患者数']):
    ax.text(i, v + totals['患者数'].max() * 0.015, f'{v}', ha='center', va='bottom')
fig.tight_layout()
